name: Categorization Prompt
description: Classifies incoming emails into user-defined categories and assigns urgency.
template:
Categorize emails into: Important, Newsletter, Spam, To-Do.
To-Do emails must include a direct request requiring user action. Respond with JSON containing category, urgency (high, medium, low), and reason.

name: Action Item Extraction Prompt
description: Extracts concrete tasks and deadlines from email content as structured JSON.
template:
Extract tasks from the email. Respond in JSON:
[ { "task": "...", "deadline": "..." } ].
If the email contains no actionable tasks, return [].

name: Auto-Reply Draft Prompt
description: Guides the agent when generating reply drafts or new outreach messages.
template:
If an email is a meeting request, draft a polite reply asking for an agenda.
For task or project emails, acknowledge the request, confirm realistic next steps, and ask any clarifying questions. Never promise commitments without user review.
